scenes.tts: Mature N G F keeps neurons alive. So how could it kill cells that lack Track A?
scenes.caption: Mature NGF keeps neurons alive. So how could it kill cells that lack TrkA?
scenes.visual: Title card: Reading One Factor Two Ways. A healthy sympathetic neuron beside a dying oligodendrocyte, both given mature NGF.
scenes.narration: Mature NGF keeps neurons alive. So how could it kill cells that lack TrkA?

scenes.tts: And why did the precursor kill neurons in one lab, but keep them weakly alive in another?
scenes.visual: Two lab notebooks with opposite results for proNGF.
scenes.narration: And why did the precursor kill neurons in one lab, but keep them weakly alive in another?

scenes.tts: Simple binding arithmetic helps with the first question. The precursor needs its pro domain.
scenes.caption: Simple binding arithmetic helps with the first question. The precursor needs its pro-domain.
scenes.visual: A dial for free mature NGF concentration appears, with two empty bars: Trk-linked sites and p75-alone sites.
scenes.narration: Simple binding arithmetic helps with the first question. The precursor needs its pro-domain.

scenes.tts: Binding studies on chick sensory neurons found two classes of N G F site.
scenes.caption: Binding studies on chick sensory neurons found two classes of NGF site.
scenes.visual: A neuron with two kinds of site, tight and loose.
scenes.narration: Binding studies on chick sensory neurons found two classes of NGF site.

scenes.tts: Their dissociation constants were about twenty picomolar and two nanomolar.
scenes.caption: Their dissociation constants were about 20 pM and 2 nM.
scenes.visual: On screen: Kd about 20 pM and 2 nM.
scenes.narration: Their dissociation constants were about 20 pM and 2 nM.

scenes.tts: Treat these as orders of magnitude, about ten picomolar and one nanomolar. The two kinds of site are a hundredfold apart.
scenes.visual: On screen: about 10 pM for Trk-linked sites, about 1 nM for p75 alone; a hundredfold apart.
scenes.narration: Treat these as orders of magnitude, about ten picomolar and one nanomolar. The two kinds of site are a hundredfold apart.

scenes.tts: A dissociation constant, K d, is the free concentration that fills half the sites. Below it, fewer than half fill.
scenes.visual: Formula on screen: fraction occupied = [NGF] / ([NGF] + Kd). Note: at [NGF] = Kd, half full.
scenes.narration: A dissociation constant, K d, is the free concentration that fills half the sites. Below it, fewer than half fill.

scenes.tts: Pick a low level for illustration, ten picomolar of mature N G F. Which sites fill?
scenes.caption: Pick a low level for illustration, ten picomolar of mature NGF. Which sites fill?
scenes.visual: The dial turns to 10 pM. Label: chosen example. Question on screen: Trk-linked or p75?
scenes.narration: Pick a low level for illustration, ten picomolar of mature NGF. Which sites fill?

scenes.tts: About half of the Track sites fill. Only about one percent of the p seventy five sites do.
scenes.caption: About half of the Trk sites fill. Only about one percent of the p75 sites do.
scenes.visual: Trk bar rises to 50%. p75 bar barely moves: 1%.
scenes.narration: About half of the Trk sites fill. Only about one percent of the p75 sites do.

scenes.tts: So at low levels, a much larger fraction of the high affinity sites fills than of the p seventy five sites. Survival depends on signals this count leaves out.
scenes.visual: Bars only: Trk-linked 50%, p75-alone 1%. Note: fractions of sites, not signal.
scenes.narration: So at low levels, a much larger fraction of the high-affinity sites fills than of the p75 sites. Survival depends on signals this count leaves out.
scenes.caption: So at low levels, a much larger fraction of the high-affinity sites fills than of the p75 sites. Survival depends on signals this count leaves out.

scenes.tts: Now turn the dial to about two nanomolar. Culture experiments often add N G F in this range.
scenes.caption: Now turn the dial to about 2 nM. Culture experiments often add NGF in this range.
scenes.visual: Dial turns to about 2 nM. On screen: 50 ng/mL of NGF dimer, about 2 nM.
scenes.narration: Now turn the dial to about 2 nM. Culture experiments often add NGF in this range.

scenes.tts: The Track sites are nearly full. And roughly half to two thirds of the p seventy five sites fill too.
scenes.caption: The Trk sites are nearly full. And roughly half to two thirds of the p75 sites fill too.
scenes.visual: Trk bar near 100%. p75 bar rises to between 50% and 67%. Note: 50% with the measured 2 nM Kd, 67% with Kd rounded to 1 nM.
scenes.narration: The Trk sites are nearly full. And roughly half to two thirds of the p75 sites fill too.

scenes.tts: So in a dish, mature N G F fills many p seventy five sites. That fits it killing Track A lacking cells there.
scenes.caption: So in a dish, mature NGF fills many p75 sites. That fits it killing TrkA-lacking cells there.
scenes.visual: p75-alone bar half to two-thirds full. Label: fits the culture results; occupancy only.
scenes.narration: So in a dish, mature NGF fills many p75 sites. That fits it killing TrkA-lacking cells there.

scenes.tts: But filling a site is not the same as signaling. The model has no threshold for survival or death.
scenes.visual: Caution card: occupancy is not signal; no survival or death threshold.
scenes.narration: But filling a site is not the same as signaling. The model has no threshold for survival or death.

scenes.tts: Nor can it explain the precursor. At a low dose where mature N G F added no death, the precursor killed.
scenes.caption: Nor can it explain the precursor. At a low dose where mature NGF added no death, the precursor killed.
scenes.visual: The two culture columns from chapter 5 return: mature NGF, no added death; uncleavable proNGF, more cells die.
scenes.narration: Nor can it explain the precursor. At a low dose where mature NGF added no death, the precursor killed.

scenes.tts: What the precursor adds is the pro domain. Sortilin grips it, and in the cells tested, the precursor's death signal needed sortilin.
scenes.caption: What the precursor adds is the pro-domain. Sortilin grips it, and in the cells tested, the precursor's death signal needed sortilin.
scenes.visual: The pro-domain tail lights up; sortilin grips it beside p75.
scenes.narration: What the precursor adds is the pro-domain. Sortilin grips it, and in the cells tested, the precursor's death signal needed sortilin.

scenes.tts: This lesson puts no binding numbers on pro N G F. Its effects are compared by experiment instead.
scenes.caption: This lesson puts no binding numbers on proNGF. Its effects are compared by experiment instead.
scenes.visual: On screen: proNGF, no binding numbers; compared by experiment.
scenes.narration: This lesson puts no binding numbers on proNGF. Its effects are compared by experiment instead.

scenes.tts: So the cut shifts the balance. It does not flip a switch.
scenes.visual: A balance scale tilts, rather than a switch flipping. Labels: mature NGF reaches p75 at culture doses; proNGF gave weak TrkA survival in one lab.
scenes.narration: So the cut shifts the balance. It does not flip a switch.

scenes.tts: Why did the precursor kill in one lab, and support weak survival in another? That is still open.
scenes.visual: The two lab notebooks return, with a question mark between them.
scenes.narration: Why did the precursor kill in one lab, and support weak survival in another? That is still open.

scenes.tts: The dose, the receptor balance, and how much precursor was cut during the experiment could each matter.
scenes.visual: Three tags on the notebooks: dose; receptor balance; precursor cut during the experiment. Label: unsettled.
scenes.narration: The dose, the receptor balance, and how much precursor was cut during the experiment could each matter.

scenes.tts: Three variables now go a long way. First, whether the factor has been cut.
scenes.visual: Three cards appear. Card one: the cut.
scenes.narration: Three variables now go a long way. First, whether the factor has been cut.

scenes.tts: Second, which receptors the cell makes. Third, how much of each.
scenes.visual: Card two: the receptor set. Card three: the amounts.
scenes.narration: Second, which receptors the cell makes. Third, how much of each.

scenes.tts: Change any one, and the same factor can mean something else.
scenes.visual: The three cards feed into one cell, whose response shifts between more survival signaling and more death signaling.
scenes.narration: Change any one, and the same factor can mean something else.

scenes.tts: Remember the rule. The target supplies the factor. The receptors decide what it means.
scenes.visual: The rule card returns, shortened: the target supplies the factor; the receptors decide what it means.
scenes.narration: Remember the rule. The target supplies the factor. The receptors decide what it means.

scenes.tts: Next, see how competing neurons use p seventy five against each other.
scenes.caption: Next, see how competing neurons use p75 against each other.
scenes.visual: Bridge card: next lesson, competition for targets.
scenes.narration: Next, see how competing neurons use p75 against each other.

scenes.tts: The takeaway: dose changes which sites fill. The cut changes which receptors the factor works through best.
scenes.visual: Takeaway on screen: dose changes which sites fill; the cut changes which receptors the factor works through best.
scenes.narration: The takeaway: dose changes which sites fill. The cut changes which receptors the factor works through best.
